method.level0: fewer high-level, topic-covering prompts; grouped from L1
method.level2: all L1 questions plus additional concrete follow-ups; 1.5-2x L1 count
method.provenance: L1 has original Guide crosswalk; L0 and newly written L2 followups are editorial adaptations, not claimed verbatim

level0.question: What were your early life and family influences?
What interests have you had outside your work?

level1.question: What was your early family life like?

level1.question: What hobbies have you enjoyed outside work?
level1.original_question:  Children - ideals of parenting, hopes and ambitions for children * Leisure and hobbies – what have been your main enthusiasms outside work  Friends how important have friends been to you?
